fixed_constraints: Native-equivalence rule: Can operations compile into matching native JavaScript/Bun operations, admitting adapters purely for Can contract and immutability enforcement. External users number zero, hence historic syntax, ABI, layouts, and goldens merit zero compatibility spend; favor compiler spareness wherever meaning endures.

Witnessed Bun 1.4 behavior: Bun.serve binds in the calling tick; stop(closeActiveConnections?) returns void in the calling tick; stop(false) finishes airborne requests and turns away fresh connections; hostname defaults to localhost; port 0 draws an ephemeral assignment; out-of-range or fractional ports raise RangeError in the calling tick; unresolvable or NUL-bearing hosts raise in the calling tick; occupying a taken port raises Error code EADDRINUSE.
